images.caption: Figure 1:Overall model performance on OmniCompass-VL.Gemini-3.8-Flash and Kimi-K3 achieve the highest scores among proprietary and open-source models, respectively, at 42.8% and 39.6%.

Figure 2:Overview of OmniCompass.The benchmark spans four dimensions:
target specification, video evidence, task coverage, and video duration.
PairedText/Text+Imagespecifications are evaluated on the same
targets. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances, while the
240-video OmniCompass-AV subset contains 720 instances with native audio.
Both tracks cover temporal grounding, spatial grounding, and question answering.

Figure 3:Data construction pipeline.OmniCompass requires about1,800 human-hoursfor rigorous annotation, verification, and revision.Stage 1:We screen 8,489 videos from nine public datasets, retain 6,946 after duration and referential-cue filtering, and select 580 to complement 240 self-collected videos.Stage 2:Four trained annotators independently construct pairedTextandText+ImageTG, SG, and QA instances. AV cases include native audio.Stage 3:Annotators cross-verify and revise cases before final acceptance and correction by the lead expert, yielding 820 videos across seven domains, paired settings, two tracks, three tasks, and three duration groups.

Figure E1:Temporal Grounding prompts for OmniCompass-VL.Both settings receive the same uniformly sampled, timestamped video frames without audio and predict the same event interval. Only the target
specification changes from a textual description to a reference image.

Figure E2:Spatial Grounding prompts for OmniCompass-VL.Both settings receive the same uniformly sampled, timestamped video frames and the same temporal interval. They localize the same target at the two
interval endpoints; only the target specification changes.

Figure E3:Question Answering prompts for OmniCompass-VL.Both settings receive the same uniformly sampled, timestamped video frames and retain the same answer choices and ground truth. Only the target
specification changes.

Figure E4:Temporal Grounding prompts for OmniCompass-AV.Both settings receive the same timestamped video frames and corresponding
audio, and predict the same audio-visual event interval. Only the target
specification changes.

Figure E5:Spatial Grounding prompts for OmniCompass-AV.Both settings receive the same timestamped video frames, corresponding audio,
and temporal interval. They localize the same target at the two interval
endpoints; only the target specification changes.

Figure E6:Question Answering prompts for OmniCompass-AV.Both settings receive the same timestamped video frames, corresponding audio,
and answer candidates. The correct answer is unchanged across target
specifications.
